paragraphs.chinese:
这一集里，克莱尔和米切尔的母亲迪迪重新回到了这个家庭。她希望大家原谅她在杰和格洛丽亚的婚礼上闹出的事，但让全家人再次聚到一起，只制造了另一场灾难。

迪迪突然出现在米切尔和卡梅隆家里。她说自己要和新男友搬去加拿大，但在离开之前，她需要和家里人和解。

问题出在杰和格洛丽亚的婚礼上。迪迪当时喝得烂醉，发表了一通羞辱格洛丽亚的讲话，最后还被人抬出了现场。被抬走的路上，她又撞倒了婚礼蛋糕。现在，她让米切尔替她取得大家的同意，好让她来参加家庭晚餐并正式道歉。

米切尔答应了，尽管卡梅隆看得出来，迪迪是在让儿子替自己解决问题。克莱尔也不喜欢这个主意。她说米切尔总是在替母亲收拾烂摊子。杰愿意让迪迪过来，却拒绝提前告诉格洛丽亚，因为他知道格洛丽亚绝不会同意。

与此同时，海莉想和迪伦去参加一场通宵演唱会，但克莱尔和菲尔不同意。迪迪随后告诉海莉，克莱尔年轻时也交过一个很疯狂的男朋友。克莱尔不想表现得像自己的母亲，于是邀请迪伦来吃晚饭，并答应如果他表现不错，就重新考虑演唱会的事。

杰家里还有一个较小的问题。曼尼参加聚会时睡着了，几个男孩在他脸上画了一撮胡子。杰让他报复回去，可曼尼把这个建议执行得太过火，竟然点燃了其中一个男孩的自行车。

当天晚上，杰和格洛丽亚来到克莱尔家，发现迪迪正在等他们。格洛丽亚非常生气，因为没有人事先警告她。迪迪做出了一番听起来很真诚的道歉，还说就算格洛丽亚想打她，她也不会怪她。

结果，格洛丽亚很平静地说自己原谅她了。迪迪完全没准备好面对这个反应。她突然失控扑向格洛丽亚，其他家人只好把她们拉开。杰终于告诉迪迪，格洛丽亚并没有抢走他，他们的婚姻早在很多年前就已经开始破裂了。

接着，迪伦说了一番让所有人意外的话。他说，虽然这个家庭又吵又古怪，但大家显然都很爱彼此。克莱尔和菲尔非常感动，于是决定允许海莉去演唱会。

然后，迪伦唱起了一首为海莉写的情歌。一开始听起来很甜蜜，可歌词很快就变得非常不合适。克莱尔和菲尔立刻改变了主意。

这顿晚餐彻底乱成一团，但那首歌实在太洗脑了，以至于第二天早上，全家人还都在哼唱它。
paragraphs.english:
This episode brings Claire and Mitchell’s mother, DeDe, back into the family. She wants everyone to forgive her for ruining Jay and Gloria’s wedding, but getting the whole family together again only creates another disaster.

DeDe suddenly shows up at Mitchell and Cameron’s house. She says she’s moving to Canada with her new boyfriend, but before she goes, she needs to make peace with the family.

The problem is what happened at Jay and Gloria’s wedding. DeDe got very drunk, gave a speech insulting Gloria, and had to be carried out. On the way, she knocked over the wedding cake. Now she asks Mitchell to get permission for her to come to the family dinner so she can apologize.

Mitchell agrees, even though Cameron can see that DeDe is making him solve her problem for her. Claire isn’t happy about the idea either. She says Mitchell always cleans up their mother’s messes. Jay is willing to let DeDe come, but he refuses to tell Gloria because he knows she’ll never agree.

Meanwhile, Haley wants to go to an overnight concert with Dylan, but Claire and Phil say no. DeDe then tells Haley that Claire also had a wild boyfriend when she was young. Claire doesn’t want to act like her own mother, so she invites Dylan to dinner and promises to reconsider if he makes a good impression.

There’s also a smaller problem at Jay’s house. Some boys draw a mustache on Manny while he’s asleep at a party. Jay tells him to get them back, but Manny takes the advice too far and sets one boy’s bike on fire.

That evening, Jay and Gloria arrive at Claire’s house and find DeDe waiting for them. Gloria is furious because no one warned her. DeDe gives what sounds like a sincere apology and says she wouldn’t blame Gloria for wanting to punch her.

Instead, Gloria calmly says she forgives her. DeDe isn’t ready for that response. She suddenly loses control and attacks Gloria, and the rest of the family has to pull them apart. Jay finally tells DeDe that Gloria didn’t steal him. Their marriage had been falling apart for years.

Dylan then surprises everyone by saying that, even though the family is loud and strange, they clearly love one another. Claire and Phil are so impressed that they decide Haley can go to the concert.

Then Dylan sings a romantic song he wrote for her. It sounds sweet at first, but the lyrics quickly become very inappropriate. Claire and Phil immediately change their minds.

The dinner is a complete mess, but the song is so catchy that the whole family is still singing it the next morning.
